title: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1679)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Fontainebleau (1679)", at revision 1332449720, opens: "The Treaty of Fontainebleau, signed on 23 August (O.S.) / 2 September 1679, ended hostilities between Denmark-Norway and the Swedish Empire in the Scanian War. Denmark, pressured by France, restored all conquests made during the war to Sweden in turn for a "paltry indemnity". The treaty was confirmed, detailed and amended in the subsequent Peace of Lund." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3487327, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1679 peace treaty between Denmark-Norway and the Swedish Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
